subject: Renewal: proposed capacity & model mix for 48k context + reranker
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Raman <priya@acme-retail.com>, Thomas Li <thomas.li@acme-retail.com>
Cc:  
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion — capacity & model mix for next term

Hi Priya / Thomas,

As we discussed in last week's checkpoint, ACME's workload is shifting toward the new long-context generation model (atlas-48k-v2) plus the reranker add-on we deployed in Q1. That model mix materially increases sustained GPU utilization and peak KV-cache pressure. To avoid throttles and preserve p95 latency targets during your Black Friday load tests, I'd like to propose the following for the 12‑month renewal: 

- Dedicated reserved pool: 6 H100s (primary) + 4 A100s (burst), colocated in us-west-2.
- Throughput guarantees: baseline throughput equivalent to 1.2M tokens/minute with automatic burst to 1.8M tokens/min for 15 minutes per hour.
- Latency SLOs: p95 < 120ms for generative requests (avg 2k token context), p95 < 80ms for reranker calls.
- Model mix & migration: we will host atlas-48k-v2 (quantized) alongside your existing 16k variant for a staged rollout; KV cache warmup plan included.
- Commercials: estimated uplift vs current commit ~ +40% for committed capacity; we can phase billing to smooth cashflow.

I attached a capacity proposal (capacity_proposal_ACME_v3.pdf) and a draft SOW with rollout windows. Key asks from my side: confirm whether H100 is mandatory for ACME (we can simulate an H100+A100 mix if needed) and procurement contact so we can send an updated contract.

If this looks directionally correct, I can loop in Marissa (renewals) and Vivek (solutions/ops) for the final pricing and SOW edits. Would you be open to a 30-minute call early next week to walk through the plan?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com

Thanks Alex — appreciate the clear proposal. A couple quick clarifying questions before we book time: 

1) Is the 6 H100 + 4 A100 split based on latency-only testing, or do you have throughput-based sizing for the reranker pipeline included in the appendix? (we expect retriever + rerank per query to be ~1.8x cost compared to our current gen-only calls)

2) Our procurement window for a May effective date is tight. Can you confirm the minimum lead time for provisioning the dedicated pool?

3) On the migration: can we schedule a 2-week canary where both atlas-16k and atlas-48k-v2 are in production behind traffic split? We want to validate RL-based re-ranking results before full cutover.

If those are okay, I'll loop in procurement (cc'd separately) and we can get a SOW executed. Also cc'ing Thomas for infra budget sign-off.

Best,

Alex / Vivek — attached is a pricing & SOW option set (SOW_ACME_reranker_draft.docx). High level: 

Option A — H100 primary (recommended)
- Reserved: 6 x H100 (us-west-2) + 4 x A100 burst
- Commercials: +38% commit vs current; 12‑month term; 3‑month intro credit = 25% off committed usage months 1–3
- Ops: 7 business day lead time for provisioning; 24–48 hour staging window for model rollout; included KV cache warmup runbook.

Option B — Mixed (cost-optimized)
- Reserved: 4 x H100 + 6 x A100
- Commercials: +30% commit vs current; 12‑month term; 1‑month intro credit = 15% off months 1–1
- Ops: 5 business day lead time; slightly higher p95 on worst-case long-context tails (est ±20ms).

Canary / Rollout plan (both options):
- 2-week canary with 10% production traffic to atlas-48k-v2
- Daily evals and regression alerts against the reference prompt set; automatic rollback if reranker precision drops > 2 pts or latency jumps > 30%

Next steps I propose:
1) Alex to confirm preferred option with Priya.
2) I will send redlined SOW and DocuSign for procurement.
3) Schedule 30-minute kickoff after signed SOW to confirm calendarized provisioning.

I can push Option A into DocuSign with the 3‑month credit if they want a soft landing. Vivek — please confirm provisioning ETA if we agree to Option A.

Thanks,
